<function name="GetSequenceVelocity" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns an entity's sequence velocity at given animation frame.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<added>2022.06.08</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="sequenceId" type="number">The sequence index.</arg>
		<arg name="cycle" type="number">The point in animation, from `0` to `1`.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Vector">Velocity of the sequence at given point in the animation.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
